text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bubble Gum Fellow didn't show up
when it was time for training, so as I was
searching around for her—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer! Sorry for worrying you!
My phone died so I couldn't get in touch.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Um... I wanted to buy some limited-edition sweets... and the line ended up way longer than I expected.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
After waiting in line, it felt frustrating to give up halfway...
...I'm so sorry!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I made sure to firmly warn Bubble Gum Fellow
so that she wouldn't repeat the same mistake.
